name: Gorrm's Reckoning
description: A reckoner's book kept by a man who hated reckoners: every Unroped soul at Ghastow, the price their clan was asked, and the price struck through as the Unroped say it has been paid. The first entry is Gorrm's own, a hundred head, and under it in another hand the Moot's finding that the man he was priced for fell.

name: The Keener's Roll
description: A roll of kid-skin the length of a man, written close on both sides in a Skarl memory-keeper's hand: every name carried up to Orrdun in three hundred years, in the order they came, and the last line blank. It smells of candle-smoke and cold.

name: Token of No Clan
description: A bone token the size of a thumb-joint, pierced for a thong and polished by water, cut on its face with a closed hand. Every clan in the heights has a mark, and every family, and this is none of them.

name: The Lead Beast's Bell
description: A Skarl drove-bell of bronze gone green, its leather strap turned to horn by fifty-five winters of frost. Swung, it gives the water note, the one the young beasts learn at the drove-well: the note a drove will come to from a mile off in any weather.

name: A Letter in a Salt Isles Tin
description: A letter never sent, folded small in a Salt Isles tin that has kept it dry under the Leadhouse hearth for forty years: an Oskel hand, a son to his mother, the night the last Salt boat sailed.

name: A Chain-Tag from Ghastow's Gate
description: A tag of lead, stamped with a Kharrow mark, fallen from one of the broken chains on Old Ghastow's gate.

name: A Bier-Bearer's Tally
description: A strip of hide knotted with the count of biers a Skarl bearer carried up to Orrdun, left on the bier-stone.

name: A Water-Keeper's Warning
description: A slate chalked by a Skarl water-keeper and wedged between the knee-bones at the Brakh's Drink.

name: Pennant's Weather-Book
description: A Sayer's weather-book in oilcloth, left open on the bench by the gauges: six winters of the moor, twice a day.

name: Hodd's Lintel-Book
description: The quarry-master's book of every lintel Skerrfall cut, with the hold it went to, hung on a nail by the bench.

name: The Wall-Book
description: A book kept between the two fires at the Wall-Keepers' Ring, written by both keepers in turn, a line each, and never both on the same day.

name: A Reckoner's Table of Prices
description: A board chalked with the reckoner's standard prices, hung inside the Reckoner's Hut door for anybody who comes to ask.

name: Bressa's Round
description: A string of heather knots hung inside the bield door, each knot a place, read by feel.

name: A Rubbing from the Turned Stone
description: A charcoal rubbing on bark of the one headstone at the Faceless Graves that lies face-up.

name: A Courier's Letter
description: A Tollmere courier's letter-case, chewed at one corner, found in the Whelping Hole.

name: A Herder's Count at the Sorting Ground
description: A Skarl herder's tally of what the thralls carried, scratched on a flake of pavement.

name: Jory Wool's Wool-Book
description: A Valish wool-buyer's account book, nineteen years of it, kept on a shelf in Uldra's byre.

name: The Leadhouse Tide-Book
description: A Salt Isles tide-book, water-stained and swollen, nailed to the Leadhouse wall by a factor who expected to come back for it.

name: Haska's Chalk-Book
description: A stone-cutter's chalk-book of the Red Moor's stones, the names set out in chalk before they are cut.

name: Chalk on the Bricked Doors
description: A page torn from a Skarl herder's book, copying the chalk-marks on Ghorrow's seven bricked doors.

name: A Scree-Hag's Catch-String
description: A gut string of things fished out of the Hidden Tarn, hung on the scree and left.

name: An Oskel Herder's Balk-Tally
description: A herder's stick, notched for every beast that balked at the Jawbone this spring.

name: Scratched on a Rib of the Wall
description: A rib-flake split off the bone wall at the Briar's End, scratched on the inner face.

name: A Spoil-Picker's Slate
description: A child's slate from the Deadground, a line of chalk crosses on it running up toward a circle, like a map of something moving.

name: Chalk off Ruddale Bridge
description: A copy, on the back of a Rudd herd-tally, of what somebody chalked on Ruddale Bridge's parapet.

name: The Shieling Fire-Book
description: The herders' book of the Oskel Shieling fire: who kept it each night, and whether the mine sang.

name: A Rudd Child's Count
description: A child's count of the Giant's Spine, pencilled on a scrap of Rudd tally-cloth and weighted with a stone in the heather.

name: A Skarl Herder's Complaint
description: A complaint to the Moot, folded small and never sent, left weighted under a rib in the Bonefield by a herder who thought better of it.

name: A Rubbing from the Far Anchor
description: A charcoal rubbing on bark of the marks cut into the far anchor of Ghast's Broken Bridge, taken from a rope at low water.

name: The Chain-Wards' Pitch Tally
description: A Rudd tapper's tally of pitch laid on the Chain Bridge's four chains, tied to the near post.

name: An Oath Fallen from the Ribs
description: A slip of bark fallen out of an oath-crack in the Rib Cathedral, the writing on it in a careful hand.

name: What Is Cut in the Last Riser
description: A rubbing of the last riser of the Giants' Stair, taken by somebody who climbed to where it stops.

name: The Unroped's Roll
description: A roll of stitched hides kept in the secret store under Ghastow's keep, every exile who came up the moor written on it in several hands, with their price.

name: The Last Bier-List
description: The last page of a Skarl memory-keeper's bier-list, soft with ninety years of cold, the names in it getting larger toward the foot of the page.

name: A Spout-Keeper's Slate
description: A slate chalked by some keeper of Skarl Spout long before Ossa, wedged in a dry niche where the underground lake begins, the chalk still legible.
